description:
To Watch The Find The Bottom Masterclass click here 👉🏻 https://www.findthebottom.live/o

A very simple and effective tool used for 18 years—RSI explained in a simplified way. 🔥

In this video I’m discussing, What RSI (Relative Strength Index) is, how it works like a speedometer, and how to identify bullish, bearish, and sideways trends using 40 and 60 levels.  📊

Here’s what you’ll learn:-Unconventional RSI approach, range shifts, support and resistance, strong bullish and bearish zones, and how trends shift from one phase to another using charts and examples.

Stay tuned To understand RSI range shift, test your learning, and see how monthly RSI helps identify value buying opportunities during crashes. 🔥
